hotels.title: HYATT REGENCY TOKYO BAY LPP
hotels.description: Set on the edge of Tokyo Bay, this polished stay places you within easy reach of the Tokyo Disney Resort and the waterfront promenades of Urayasu. The hotel’s contemporary rooms frame sweeping bay or city views, while the surrounding area offers access to Tokyo Bay’s cycling paths and sea-facing parks. Dining is centred on Japanese and international dishes served in a refined setting, with a café for lighter bites and drinks. Nearby, Maihama Station connects you to central Tokyo, while the nearby Shin-Urayasu area offers shopping, casual eateries and local convenience stores
